general.title: General Questions
general.a1: CarsPlatform is a comprehensive car information platform that allows you to search, compare, and review cars. We provide detailed specifications, user reviews, and real-world fuel consumption data.
general.a2: Yes, CarsPlatform is completely free to use. You can browse cars, read reviews, and check fuel reports without any cost. Registration is only required for adding reviews and fuel reports.
general.q3: How do I create an account?
general.a3: Click the 'Sign Up' button in the top right corner of the page. Fill in your details including username, email, and password. After registration, you can immediately start contributing to the platform.

reviews.title: Reviews & Ratings
reviews.a1: Car ratings are averaged from all user reviews. Each review rates the car across 11 different categories, and the overall rating is the average of all category scores.
reviews.a2: Yes, you can edit your reviews at any time from your profile page. Simply navigate to your reviews section and click the edit button on any review you've submitted.
reviews.q3: Why was my review not published?
reviews.a3: All reviews go through a moderation process to ensure quality. If your review doesn't meet our guidelines (e.g., contains inappropriate content, is too short, or lacks substance), it may be rejected.

fuel.title: Fuel Reports
fuel.a1: Users can submit fuel consumption reports for cars they own or drive regularly. Each report includes average fuel consumption, driving conditions, and other relevant details.
fuel.q2: How accurate are the fuel consumption figures?
fuel.a2: Fuel consumption figures are based on real user reports. We average all submitted reports to provide the most accurate estimate possible. Keep in mind that actual consumption may vary based on driving style, conditions, and vehicle maintenance.

comparison.title: Car Comparison
comparison.q1: How many cars can I compare at once?
comparison.a1: You can compare up to 4 cars at once. This allows you to see specifications, ratings, and fuel consumption side by side for easier comparison.
comparison.a2: Currently, comparisons are stored in your browser session. If you close your browser, the comparison will be reset. We recommend taking screenshots if you want to save a comparison.
